caption:
Mr Turtle has just started as cabin crew, and after a long-haul his legs feel swollen and his shoulders stiff.

Long hours standing or sitting, pushing carts and lifting bags overhead can leave the body worn out. Remedial massage can help ease muscle tension, and it works well alongside moving regularly on board.

Hybi's in-flight routine: 10 slow calf raises, 10 ankle circles each side, and keep bags close when lifting.

If one calf is swollen, sore or warm, skip the massage and see your GP promptly. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help with the rest. Book online via the link in bio ✈️

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
